scientific_integrity: Exact finite graph-classification and all-fitness polynomial argument; independently reconstructed Markov systems at seven rational parameters. Same-model review only; no external scientific certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to strongly connected loopless unweighted digraphs up to three sites and up to six arcs on four sites, fixed-fitness birth-death update. Historical priority beyond inspected works and larger/weighted graph classes remain open.
title: The unique six-arc four-site fitness-ranking reversal in the directed Moran process
